description: Fetch the current Crypto Fear & Greed Index, its history, a date range, or an intraday CFGI view. Choose alternative.me, CoinMarketCap or CFGI. No API key, login or proxy.

classificationFilter.description: Keep only readings in one sentiment band (historical and dateRange modes). Leave empty to keep every band.
classificationFilter.title: Classification filter

endDate.description: Inclusive end of the range, e.g. 2024-12-31 (mode=dateRange).
endDate.title: End date (date range)

limit.description: How many of the most recent readings to return in historical mode. One reading per day for daily sources.
limit.title: Number of readings (historical)

mode.description: What to fetch: the current reading, the last N readings, or a custom date range.
enumTitles: Date range — readings between two dates
mode.title: Mode

source.description: Which publisher to read. alternative.me has daily history since 2018; CoinMarketCap since 2023 with BTC price and volume; CFGI has daily history since 2022 plus short rolling 4h/1h/15m windows, a 10-component breakdown and market cap.
enumTitles: CoinMarketCap — daily history since 2023 + BTC context
CFGI — daily or intraday + component scores
source.title: Index source

startDate.description: Inclusive start of the range, e.g. 2024-01-01. Slash dates and US dates are also accepted (mode=dateRange).
startDate.title: Start date (date range)

timeframe.description: Reading interval for the CFGI source only: daily, 4-hour, hourly or 15-minute. CFGI intraday history is a short rolling window; other sources always return daily readings.
timeframe.title: CFGI timeframe

title: Crypto Fear & Greed Index Scraper Input
